hotels.title: Malta Oceanfront Escape in the Heart of St Julian's with Daily Breakfast, Guaranteed Sea Views & Dinner
hotels.description: Perched on the sparkling shores of Malta's favourite coastal hubs, Verdi St. George's Bay Marina puts the island's best dining and entertainment right at your door. Every room faces the sea, with panoramic views of the bay that make the most of Malta's legendary sunshine from the moment you arrive. Dine on the outdoor terrace at Mananni Restaurant, a celebration of authentic Maltese cuisine, showcasing traditional flavours and local ingredients. Step outside into St Julian’s - offering some of the islands best waterfront dining, shopping and nightlife. Valletta's UNESCO-listed streets are a 10-minute drive and the ancient walled city of Mdina is 20 minutes away for a slower afternoon.
